discussions.prompt: Why did Achromobacter sp. SL8 monoculture Cd removal efficiency drop by 15.8% (from 82.6% at 50 mg/L to 69.55% at 100 mg/L Cd2+) despite SL8 having a higher Cd(II) MIC (600 mg/L) than Enterobacter sp. SL12 (400 mg/L)?
attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Cadmium Immobilization, Alkalinization, and N-H Surface Coordination by Achromobacter sp. SL8 Monoculture
discussions.rationale: TEM imaging (Fig. 4B) showed cell-membrane thinning and blurring in SL8 at 100 mg/L Cd2+, whereas SL12 retained intact cell wall morphology (Fig. 4D) and increased its removal efficiency from 63.4% to 70.8%, suggesting that N-H binding site saturation or membrane perturbation limits SL8 monoculture performance at 100 mg/L Cd2+.

evidence.snippet: Specifically, SL8 exhibited a decrease in RE-Cd under higher Cd stress, consistent with previous reports that elevated Cd levels enhance cellular toxicity and reduce biosorption capacity
evidence.explanation: Documents the decrease in SL8 monoculture Cd removal at 100 mg/L Cd2+.

discussions.prompt: Why does Achromobacter sp. ZM-2 achieve the earliest stationary phase and highest peak cell density (OD600 = 0.91 at 28 h) among the three isolates on prometryn while exhibiting the lowest 48-h parent-compound removal (85.1% vs 97.3% for ZM-1 and 92.8% for ZM-3)?
attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Axenic Liquid and Soil Microcosm Prometryn Catabolism by Achromobacter sp. ZM-2
discussions.rationale: PMID:42795638 notes that pure-culture growth curves show ZM-2 entering logarithmic phase earliest and reaching stationary phase at 28 h to initiate early-stage prometryn transformation, while targeted detection of intermediate metabolites in pure vs mixed culture was deferred to follow-up work.

evidence.snippet: The staggered growth patterns of the three strains form temporal niche complementarity that sustains continuous and efficient degradation throughout the entire culture cycle: pure-culture growth curves showed that strain ZM-2 enters the logarithmic phase earliest and reaches stationary phase at 28 h, allowing it to rapidly initiate prometryn transformation in the early stage
evidence.explanation: Documents the early-stage growth role of ZM-2 in pure culture and temporal niche complementarity.
